detail: Autodesk Inc has entered into a definitive agreement with BIMDeX, wherein Autodesk acquire select technology assets and intellectual property, as well as hire a subset of the BIMXDex team. Morrison Foerster was the lead counsel for Autodesk on this acquisition Khaitan & Co advised Autodesk on the Indian law aspects of this acquisition and the hiring of a subset of the BIMDeX team in India. The core transaction team comprised Monika Srivastava (Partner), Sanchit Agarwal (Partner) and Romit Kohli (Senior Associate). The following provided support: Tax aspects: Ritu Shaktawat (Partner); Employment aspects: Abhinav Rastogi (Partner); Intellectual Property aspects: Shailendra Bhandare (Partner);…
